bucket.markdownDescription:
Bucket name

Name of the S3 bucket to pull objects from

region.markdownDescription:
Bucket region

Region of the bucket. If omitted, the AWS CLI's default region applies.

endpointUrl.markdownDescription:
S3-compatible endpoint

Endpoint URL passed to the AWS CLI as --endpoint-url, for S3-compatible stores (e.g., http://minio.internal:9000)

keys.markdownDescription:
Object keys to pull

Exact keys of objects to pull. A key may carry a pin: `releases/app.jar#versionId=<id>` pulls that object version, `releases/app.jar@sha256:<64 hex>` fails the pull when the content differs.

prefixes.markdownDescription:
Key prefixes to pull

Key prefixes to pull every object under (e.g., builds/2026-10/)

recursive.markdownDescription:
Pull objects under nested prefixes

Specifies whether [s3PullPrefixes](https://doc.log10x.com/compile/pull/s3/#s3pullprefixes) include objects under nested '/' segments. (Accepts boolean or string with $= prefix for runtime evaluation) (Default: false)

s3Command.markdownDescription:
Path to the AWS CLI

The AWS CLI program the pull runs for listing and downloading objects: a program name on the path or a full path, with optional leading arguments (e.g., `aws --profile build`). (Default: aws)
